steps.tx: **ART combines 3 drugs** from 2 classes to drive **HIV RNA below 200 copies/mL** and keep it there. **Treatment for all** at diagnosis regardless of CD4 is the rule; suppression restores immunity and **blocks transmission** (undetectable equals untransmittable). **Resistance testing at start** guides the first regimen, which works best before mutations accumulate. **Single drug therapy never** works; resistance follows within weeks.
steps.say: A R T was defined as a combination of three drugs from two classes that drove H I V R N A below two hundred copies and kept it there. Treatment for all at diagnosis regardless of C D four was recommended, as suppression restored immunity and blocked transmission. Resistance testing at start was ordered to guide the first regimen, which worked best before mutations accumulated. Single-drug therapy was never advised, as resistance followed within weeks.

steps.tx: **Start rapidly after diagnosis** once readiness with baseline tests complete; **same-day start** suits the willing. **Baseline genotype with CD4 with viral load** with renal, liver, hepatitis B with C, TB screen and pregnancy test precede drugs. **Defer only for crypto with TB meningitis**, where early ART kills. **Opportunistic cover** (co-trimoxazole below 200) starts with ART, not after.
steps.say: Rapid start after diagnosis was advised once readiness with baseline tests was completed, while same-day start suited the willing. Baseline genotype with C D four and viral load, with renal, liver, hepatitis B and C, T B screen and pregnancy test, was ordered before drugs. Deferral was reserved only for crypto with T B meningitis, where early A R T killed. Opportunistic cover with co-trimoxazole below two hundred was started with A R T, not after.

steps.tx: **Two NRTIs form the backbone**, usually **tenofovir with lamivudine or emtricitabine**; the third drug is an **integrase inhibitor**. **NNRTIs block** reverse transcriptase directly; **protease inhibitors** need boosting with ritonavir or cobicistat. **Entry blockers with capsid drugs** serve salvage, not first line. **Abacavir needs HLA testing**; hypersensitivity kills on rechallenge.
steps.say: Two N R T Is were reported to form the backbone, usually tenofovir with lamivudine or emtricitabine, while the third drug was an integrase inhibitor. N N R T Is were shown to block reverse transcriptase directly, while protease inhibitors needed boosting with ritonavir or cobicistat. Entry blockers with capsid drugs were reserved for salvage, not first line. Abacavir needed H L A testing, as hypersensitivity killed on rechallenge.

steps.tx: **TLD (tenofovir, lamivudine, dolutegravir)** leads in India as one daily pill. **Bictegravir with TAF with FTC** suits where available with kinder kidneys. **Two-drug dolutegravir with lamivudine** works only when hepatitis B is absent with RNA at or below 500,000. **Efavirenz-based** regimens stay as backup with rifampicin gaps covered. **Never swap single drugs**; change whole failing regimens together.
steps.say: T L D with tenofovir, lamivudine and dolutegravir was recommended to lead in India as one daily pill. Bictegravir with T A F and F T C was reported to suit where available with kinder kidneys. Two-drug dolutegravir with lamivudine was validated only when hepatitis B was absent with R N A at or below five hundred thousand. Efavirenz-based regimens stayed as backup with rifampicin gaps covered. Single-drug swaps were never advised, as whole failing regimens were changed together.

steps.tx: **Viral load at 4 to 8 weeks**, then **every 3 to 6 months**, judges response; **CD4 each visit** till stable above 200. **Suppression below 200 copies** defines success; blips below it without resistance are watched. **Creatinine with phosphate** tracks tenofovir kidneys; **weight with glucose** tracks dolutegravir gain. **Lipids rise on TAF** while bone with kidneys suffer on TDF. **Failure to suppress by 6 months** triggers adherence review with genotype.
steps.say: Viral load at four to eight weeks, then every three to six months, was ordered to judge response, while C D four each visit continued till stable above two hundred. Suppression below two hundred copies was defined as success, while blips below it without resistance were watched. Creatinine with phosphate was tracked for tenofovir kidneys, while weight with glucose tracked dolutegravir gain. Lipids were reported to rise on T A F, while bone with kidneys suffered on T D F. Failure to suppress by six months triggered adherence review with genotype.

steps.tx: **Tenofovir harms kidneys with bone**; dose adjusts to creatinine and swaps to TAF. **Dolutegravir adds weight** with insomnia; neural tube fears settled with continued use. **Efavirenz disturbs sleep with mood** and is avoided in pregnancy start. **Abacavir hypersensitivity** (fever, rash, gut pain) bans rechallenge forever. **Nevirapine rashes liver** in high CD4; **zidovudine anaemias** with time.
steps.say: Tenofovir was reported to harm kidneys with bone, while the dose was adjusted to creatinine and swapped to T A F. Dolutegravir was reported to add weight with insomnia, while neural tube fears settled with continued use. Efavirenz was reported to disturb sleep with mood and was avoided in pregnancy start. Abacavir hypersensitivity with fever, rash and gut pain was reported to ban rechallenge forever. Nevirapine was reported to rash liver in high C D four, while zidovudine anaemiad with time.

steps.tx: **Virologic failure is RNA at or above 200** on treatment after suppression; **adherence is checked first** before blaming drugs. **Genotype while still on** the failing regimen catches reverting mutants. **New regimen keeps 2 actives**, usually dolutegravir with boosted darunavir plus recycled NRTIs. **Treatment gaps breed** class-wide resistance; restart fast with counselling. **Drug levels** help where absorption with interactions suspected.
steps.say: Virologic failure was defined as R N A at or above two hundred on treatment after suppression, while adherence was checked first before blaming drugs. Genotype while still on the failing regimen was ordered to catch reverting mutants. The new regimen was reported to keep two actives, usually dolutegravir with boosted darunavir plus recycled N R T Is. Treatment gaps were reported to breed class-wide resistance, so restart was advised fast with counselling. Drug levels were reported to help where absorption with interactions was suspected.

steps.tx: **Rifampicin halves dolutegravir**, so **50 mg twice daily** replaces daily dosing in TB coinfection. **Hepatitis B needs tenofovir with 3TC or FTC** in the backbone; stopping flares liver fatally. **Pregnancy continues dolutegravir** with folate; efavirenz start is avoided. **Kidney failure doses** NRTIs by creatinine; **abacavir with dolutegravir** need no renal change. **HIV-2 ignores NNRTIs**; integrase with boosted PI regimens treat it.
steps.say: Rifampicin was reported to halve dolutegravir, so fifty milligrams twice daily was ordered to replace daily dosing in T B coinfection. Hepatitis B was reported to need tenofovir with three T C or F T C in the backbone, while stopping flared liver fatally. Pregnancy was reported to continue dolutegravir with folate, while efavirenz start was avoided. Kidney failure was reported to dose N R T Is by creatinine, while abacavir with dolutegravir needed no renal change. H I V two was reported to ignore N N R T Is, while integrase with boosted P I regimens treated it.

steps.tx: **IRIS unmasks TB with crypto** weeks after start as CD4 recovers; steroids calm severe cases. **Life expectancy nears normal** with early suppression; **U equals U** ends sexual transmission. **Weight with metabolic syndrome** shadows dolutegravir years; **kidney with bone** shadow tenofovir. **Aging with HIV** brings heart, kidney and cancer screening forward. **Loss to follow-up kills** more than resistance does.
steps.say: I R I S was reported to unmask T B with crypto weeks after start as C D four recovered, while steroids calmed severe cases. Life expectancy was reported to near normal with early suppression, while U equals U ended sexual transmission. Weight with metabolic syndrome was reported to shadow dolutegravir years, while kidney with bone shadowed tenofovir. Aging with H I V was reported to bring heart, kidney and cancer screening forward. Loss to follow-up was reported to kill more than resistance did.

steps.tx: **Exam traps:** single-drug lead or single swap at failure breeds resistance. **Stopping tenofovir in Hep B** flares liver; never stop backbone alone. **Normal CD4 start** still needs ART; treat all is the rule. **NNRTI for HIV-2** never works. **Blaming drugs before adherence** misses the commonest cause of failure. **Genotype after stopping** misses reverted mutants; test on the failing drugs.
steps.say: For the exam, these traps were tabulated as requested. Single-drug lead or single swap at failure was reported to breed resistance. Stopping tenofovir in Hep B was reported to flare liver, so the backbone was never stopped alone. Normal C D four at start still needed A R T, as treat-all was the rule. N N R T I for H I V two never worked. Blaming drugs before adherence was reported to miss the commonest cause of failure. Genotype after stopping was reported to miss reverted mutants, so testing on the failing drugs was advised.

steps.tx: **High yield for the exam:** treat all with **TLD daily**; **genotype at start**. **Two NRTIs with dolutegravir** lead; **DTG 50 mg twice daily** with rifampicin. **RNA below 200** defines success; **3 to 6 monthly** monitoring follows. **Two-drug DTG with 3TC** needs RNA at or below 500,000 without Hep B. **Stop tenofovir never** in Hep B; **NNRTI never** in HIV-2.
steps.say: For the exam, these high-yield facts were tabulated as requested. Treat-all with T L D daily was advised, with genotype at start. Two N R T Is with dolutegravir were reported to lead, while D T G at fifty milligrams twice daily was ordered with rifampicin. R N A below two hundred was defined as success, with three to six monthly monitoring to follow. Two-drug D T G with three T C was validated only with R N A at or below five hundred thousand without Hep B. Stopping tenofovir was never advised in Hep B, while N N R T I was never advised in H I V two.
